brief: Vanda reports massive retail selling in US single stocks in the first 30 minutes of the 5 Nov 2026 cash session, the largest 30-minute selling episode since October and on track to be the largest amount of retail selling since the late July capitulation, concentrated in tech names. In late July, retail selling continued for several days and kept going even after the market began to recover; Vanda says the clue to watch this time is institutional buying stepping in to aid any recovery. A catalyst around the 29 July low was the Situational Awareness fund's offload, and stocks that fund held in June are again among today's heaviest retail selling. The sell-off also brings CTA (systematic trend-following) selling into play: Vanda believes big CTA selling was likely avoided on election night, but having broken through 27,600 CTAs will likely turn outright short, and a clean break below 26,800 would take CTA exposure down to LibDay lows.
